messages:
marco_rel: Quick sync: rolling SDK 3.12 at 23:00 UTC. Change affects model->runtime binding heuristics; older runtimes may drop variant weights. Proposing a cautious pin/unpin flow to limit blast radius.

keiko_sre: Agreed. Suggest we prefer scope-based pins (pool-tag / tenant). Example: `rbctl runtime pin --pool-tag legacy-gpu --runtime-version v2.17 --ttl 72h --reason \"sdk3.12 compat hold\"`.

evan_eng: We added a fallback flag REDWOOD_SDK_BIND_STRICT which reverts to old behavior. If we can ship a hotpatch with that env defaulted to previous behavior, we can avoid many pins.

tori_qa: Canary runs: NA/EU stable, APAC legacy pools show 1.7% quality drift and a few 502s. With REDWOOD_SDK_BIND_STRICT=false drift drops to 0.4%.

leigh_prod: Ops playbook please: triggers for manual pin, who runs it, and CLI commands so support can act quickly.

keiko_sre: Triggers: error rate +3% sustained 5m OR quality drift >1.5% sustained 10m OR p95 > baseline+250ms for 10m. Manual owners: @keiko_sre oncall then fallback @marco_rel. CLI: `rbctl runtime pin --pool-tag legacy-gpu --runtime-version v2.17 --ttl 48h --reason "sdk3.12 compat hold"` and unpin with `rbctl runtime unpin --pool-tag legacy-gpu --reason "smoke passed"`.

evan_eng: We're cutting 3.12.1 with the env flag defaulted. ETA 22:40 UTC. If that lands, we will not pin.

deploybot: [deploybot] scheduled canaries: legacy-gpu 22:50 UTC (20m), standard-gpu 23:15 UTC (20m). Telemetry hooks active.

tori_qa: 3.12.1 published at 22:38 UTC. Canary update: legacy-gpu drift now within noise. No automatic pin triggered.

marco_rel: Good. We'll keep monitoring for 2h post-release. If triggers fire, manual pin owners execute commands above and post a rollback-ticket link. Release notes: include migration section and env flag example. Closing thread unless alerts fire.
